role_semantics.primary: may be considered as a standalone signal input only after a later explicit generator authorization
role_semantics.interaction-only: may modify an approved primary but cannot originate a standalone signal
role_semantics.condition-only: may gate or neutralize but cannot contribute standalone magnitude
role_semantics.state-only: describes environment/state and is frozen from reward until Phase B1
role_semantics.benchmark-only: provides comparison/reference values and cannot drive candidate promotion or memory
role_semantics.blocked: cannot enter feature, generator, reward, benchmark promotion, or memory paths
